notes: Step 1 parts were correct, so none were added or dropped.
The circuit has no external resistor or LED. Pin 2 uses the internal pull-up (INPUT_PULLUP). Pressing the button connects D2 to GND.
The USB cable is not in the hardware list or circuit image, so it is not included.

Breadboard naming follows the catalogue: bank 't' is rows a-e and bank 'b' is rows f-j. In the image the half labelled j-f is at the top and the half labelled e-a is at the bottom. I took the row letters from the image, so the top half is written as bank 'b' and the bottom half as bank 't'.
The pushbutton straddles the centre gap in columns 4 and 6. Its upper legs are at 4b.f and 6b.f (side 1, joined inside). Its lower legs are at 4t.e and 6t.e (side 2).

The blue wire runs from Leonardo pin 2 to 6b.i, which is the same strip as the button's side 1. The black wire runs from the first GND on the power header (GND.1, next to 5V) to 4t.c, which is the same strip as the button's side 2.
